patch.role: Space-only recomputation of the stripped column; equivalent to A for space-padded cells and a no-op for tab-padded cells.
Removes NUL characters; none of the declared inputs contain one.
Decodes one HTML entity; no declared input carries it.
Drops a sentinel control character that never appears.
lines: strings = [s for s in strings if s != "\x01"]

inputs.control_center: space-padded but center-aligned (A's branch not taken)

rationale: The adaptation restores right-alignment whitespace normalisation for space-padded cells only; tab normalisation remains A's responsibility.  Masking is claimed only on mask_spaces; expose_tabs is the legal exposing witness.

challenge.note: Only the candidate universe grows. A, the original U blocks and the declared inputs are unchanged, so every correct relation is unchanged; the added candidates are irrelevant on every declared input.
